reviews.t: Worked well with my HTC One M8 and reliably using Anker's own charging cable; a DROK multimeter is recommended

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the charger for charging devices quickly, with several noting fast charging speeds for phones and tablets.
Reviewers frequently highlight the convenience of having multiple USB ports on a single charger, reducing clutter and the need for multiple wall chargers.
Several reviewers describe the charger as a quality, well-made product that meets or exceeds expectations.
A few reviewers report negative experiences, including receiving a damaged or non-working item and one who felt it did not quick charge as expected.
Some reviewers mention the charger is pricey but consider it worth the cost for a good charger.
